Channing Tatum denies claims of running burner account for ex

Actor Channing Tatum has denied allegations that he operated a burner account on social media to follow his ex-partner Zoë Kravitz. The claims also suggested the account was used to monitor Kravitz's activities. Tatum has "furiously denied" these accusations.
